# #104 Application Error Tracking (`application-error-tracking`) — Scope of Work (SOW)

- **App Number & Name:** `#104 Application Error Tracking`
- **Proposed App Key:** `application-error-tracking`
- **Domain / Suite & Model Prefix:** `DEV` (`Dev*`) — Category `11. Software Development & DevOps`
- **Representative Benchmark (`P1`):** `Sentry`
- **Combined Feature Catalog:** [../combined-features/104-application-error-tracking-features.md](../combined-features/104-application-error-tracking-features.md)

---

## 1. Executive Outcome & Target Audience

**Application Error Tracking (`application-error-tracking`)** gives software engineering, mobile, frontend, backend, and SRE teams a real-time, code-level crash and exception intelligence hub inside the Rapider `DEV` suite. Instead of sifting through terabytes of unstructured raw text logs after customers complain, developers capture unhandled exceptions, panics, rejected promises, and mobile ANR/OOM crashes with full symbolicated stack traces, chronological pre-crash breadcrumbs, error-triggered DOM replay references, suspect commit attribution, and quantified release stability scores.

- **SME & Startup Fast-Path:** A 5-person product team creates a `DevErrorService`, copies a single DSN snippet into their web/mobile/API app, and immediately gets out-of-the-box stack deduplication, automatic PII scrubbing, release crash-free tracking, and one-click bug creation in Rapider Planning (`ApmIssue`)—with zero custom fingerprinting or query rules required.
- **Enterprise Progressive Disclosure:** Multi-squad organizations unlock declarative server-side `DevGroupingRule` fingerprinting, `CODEOWNERS`-driven `DevOwnershipRule` routing, release stability gates (`targetStabilityThreshold` / `criticalStabilityThreshold`), cross-service OpenTelemetry `traceId` correlation, automated `#105` feature-flag kill-switch hooks, and SOC2/HIPAA/GDPR field-level redaction policies.
- **Measurable Business & Engineering Outcomes:**
  1. Reduce Mean Time to Resolution (MTTR) for production application exceptions by **50%–70%** via symbolicated stack frames, breadcrumbs, and suspect commits.
  2. Achieve **99.5%+ Crash-Free Session Rates** on web and mobile releases by gating phased rollouts on real-time `DevReleaseHealth` stability scores.
  3. Eliminate **95%+ alert fatigue** by deduplicating millions of repetitive exception occurrences into canonical `DevErrorIssue` records with conditional snooze and velocity thresholds.
- **Top 6 Global Benchmarks Synthesized (`P1`–`P6`):** `Sentry` (`P1` — Representative Product), `Datadog Error Tracking` (`P2`), `BugSnag` (`P3`), `Rollbar` (`P4`), `Microsoft Azure Application Insights` (`P5`), and `ServiceNow Cloud Observability / Lightstep` (`P6`).

---

## 2. In-Scope, Out-of-Scope & Suite Ownership Boundaries

### In-Scope
- Provisioning application/service DSNs, scoped ingestion keys, CORS origin allowlists, inbound spike quotas, and server-side PII/secret scrubbing policies (`AET-001`, `AET-004`, `AET-005`).
- Ingesting structured exception envelopes (web, backend, mobile ANR/OOM), uploading release debug symbols/source maps to Platform Files, and symbolicating stack frames (`AET-002`, `AET-003`, `AET-006`).
- Deterministic & custom stack-trace fingerprinting, issue deduplication, merge/unmerge, triage state machine (`UNRESOLVED`, `FOR_REVIEW`, `RESOLVED`, `IGNORED`), automatic regression detection, and conditional snooze rules (`AET-007`–`AET-012`).
- Diagnostic inspection of chronological breadcrumbs, sanitized runtime/request context, W3C `traceId`/`spanId` links, error-triggered DOM session replay references, and user crash feedback (`AET-013`–`AET-016`, `AET-025`).
- Release Health crash-free user/session stability scoring, suspect commit attribution, cron/job check-in monitoring, alert rules, and grounded AI root-cause/fix proposals (`AET-017`–`AET-024`, `AET-026`–`AET-028`).

### Out-of-Scope
- Full host/container CPU, memory, disk, Kubernetes, and network infrastructure metrics (owned by `#083 Cloud Infrastructure Monitoring`).
- High-volume unstructured operational syslog archiving and SIEM threat correlation (owned by log management / security suites).
- Agile sprint planning, story points, velocity charts, and general backlog management (owned by `APM` / `planning`).
- Customer support omnichannel ticketing and SLA timers (owned by `SUP` / `support`).
- Hosting or executing feature flag SDK evaluation engines (owned by `#105 Feature Flag Management`).

Core End-to-End User Journeys 1. **SME 3-Minute Onboarding & First Exception Triage:** - Lead Developer opens `#/services`, clicks **New Monitored Service** (opens `service-drawer`), enters `Checkout API` (`NODE`), and saves (`DevErrorService` created, drawer auto-closes, table refreshes optimistically). - Developer uploads `v1.4.0` source maps on `#/symbols` (`uploadSymbolArtifact`) and triggers a test exception. - Navigating to `#/issues`, the developer sees `API-101: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'taxRate')`, clicks the primary link to open `#/issue-detail?id=...`, inspects the symbolicated stack line (`pricingEngine.ts:84`) and pre-crash HTTP breadcrumbs, and clicks **Create APM Bug**—creating a linked `ApmIssue` in one click. 2. **Release Stability Breach -> Home `WorkItem` -> Feature Flag Kill-Switch Handoff:** - Mobile team ships `ios-app@3.2.0` behind feature flag `new-apple-pay-sheet`. Within 15 minutes, OOM/NSException crashes drop `DevReleaseHealth.crashFreeSessionRate` to `96.40%` (below `criticalStabilityThreshold = 98.50%`). - `evaluateReleaseStability` transitions `gateStatus -> CRITICAL_BREACH`, fires `DevErrorAlertRule`, and publishes a shared Rapider Home `WorkItem` assigned to the Release Manager with a recommended action: *Disable flag `new-apple-pay-sheet` in `#105`*. - Release Manager reviews `#/release-detail`, confirms the correlation in `activeFlagVariants`, and approves the guarded kill-switch action (`proposeFlagKillSwitch`), halting crashes within seconds. 3. **Resolved Issue Regression Across Releases:** - Engineer marks `API-101` as `RESOLVED_IN_NEXT_RELEASE` (`v1.4.1`). Deployment `v1.4.1` runs cleanly for 3 days, then `v1.5.0` re-introduces the bug. - `ingestErrorEvent` detects `releaseVersion = 1.5.0 > 1.4.1` on a resolved fingerprint, transitions `API-101` back to `UNRESOLVED` (`REGRESSED`), attaches Suspect Commit `a94f21c`, re-notifies the owner via `DevOwnershipRule`, and reopens/comments on the linked `ApmIssue`. 4. **Grounded AI Root-Cause Investigation (`projectChannelMessage`):** - From `#/issue-detail`, an engineer clicks **Analyze with Rapider AI**. The backend gathers the already-scrubbed `DevErrorEvent` stack frames, breadcrumbs, and suspect commit diff, posting a grounded root-cause breakdown onto the issue's `projectChannelMessage` thread citing exact frame lines and proposing a null-guard unit test—never auto-committing code without human approval. 5. **List Filtering, Click-Through Navigation & Back State Restoration:** - On `#/issues`, a triager types `"taxRate"` into search and clicks filter pill `Environment: prod` + `Status: UNRESOLVED`. `#activeFilterTagsBar` renders `Search: "taxRate" ✕`, `Env: "prod" ✕`, `Status: "UNRESOLVED" ✕` and `[Clear all]`. - Clicking `API-101` navigates cleanly to `#/issue-detail?id=...` (no `` 404 diversion). Clicking `#btnGoBack` returns to `#/issues` with the exact active filters, search query, and scroll/list state preserved; clicking `Clear all` resets all pills to `ALL` and restores the full dataset. --- ## 6. **WP-P2-1: Cron Check-In Monitors & Crash Feedback (`AET-024`, `AET-025`):** Scheduled worker heartbeat monitor table inside `#/analytics` and end-user crash report notes attached to `DevErrorEvent`. - **WP-P2-2: Seer-Style Grounded AI Triage & Regression Test Handoff (`AET-026`–`AET-028`):** Root-cause synthesis, breadcrumb/replay text summarization, and human-gated patch + `#106` regression test drafts over `projectChannelMessage`. --- ## 7. Roles, Permissions & Field-Level Governance | Role | Permitted Actions | Restricted / Field-Level Boundaries | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Developer / Triager** | View assigned & workspace `DevErrorIssue` / `DevErrorEvent` / `DevReleaseHealth`; transition triage states (`Resolve`, `Snooze`, `For Review`); link `ApmIssue` / `SupTicket`; upload `DevSymbolArtifact`; invoke AI RCA on `projectChannelMessage`. | Cannot weaken or disable PII scrubbing rules, delete `DevErrorService`, rotate production DSNs, or purge audit logs. | | **Release / Engineering Lead** | All Developer permissions + create/edit `DevErrorService`, rotate DSN keys, author `DevGroupingRule`, `DevOwnershipRule`, and `DevErrorAlertRule`, configure `Decimal128` stability thresholds, and approve Home `WorkItem` kill-switch actions. | Cannot disable workspace-mandated global compliance redaction patterns (`scrubPiiEnabled` floor set by Security Admin). | | **Support / QA Viewer** | Read-only access to `DevErrorIssue` summaries, triage status, affected release versions, and `SupTicket` / `ApmIssue` links; export sanitized reproduction steps to `#106`. | **Field-Level Restriction:** Raw `runtimeContext` headers, environment variables, IP metadata, and `dsnPublicKey` values are masked/hidden; zero mutation permissions on `Dev*` records. | | **Security & Governance Admin** | Configure mandatory workspace PII/secret scrubbing patterns (`#/privacy-scrubbing`), data retention TTLs, GDPR subject-erasure runs, and inbound quota caps; view full policy audit history. | Cannot fabricate or mutate immutable `DevErrorEvent` stack evidence (may only trigger audited GDPR PII tombstoning). | | **Scoped Ingestion / CI Identity** | Write-only `ingestErrorEvent`, `uploadSymbolArtifact`, and `recordReleaseDeployment` scoped strictly to the single `DevErrorService` matching its token. | Zero read access to stored issues, events, or workspace configuration. | --- ## 8. Technical APIs, Guarded Commands, Events & `requiredWorkflows` ### Guarded Domain Commands (Beyond Standard SWR Reads) All state-changing commands enforce `idempotencyKey` (UUID), `correlationId` (UUID), authenticated workspace RBAC, and `expectedVersion` optimistic concurrency: - `ingestErrorEvent(dsnKey, envelope, idempotencyKey)` -> Runs inbound filter -> PII scrubber -> symbolicator -> fingerprint matcher -> atomically upserts `DevErrorIssue` counters & regressions -> appends immutable `DevErrorEvent`. - `triageIssue(issueId, targetStatus, snoozeSpec?, resolutionRelease?, expectedVersion, idempotencyKey)` -> Validates state transition, updates `DevErrorIssue`, syncs linked `ApmIssue` if configured. - `mergeIssues(primaryIssueId, secondaryIssueIds[], customFingerprintRule?, expectedVersion, idempotencyKey)` -> Re-parents occurrence metrics and creates optional `DevGroupingRule`. - `uploadSymbolArtifact(serviceId, releaseVersion, artifactType, fileId, checksumSha256, idempotencyKey)` -> Validates symbol bundle structure in Platform Files and marks `VERIFIED`. - `evaluateReleaseStability(serviceId, environment, releaseVersion, sessionBatchMetrics, idempotencyKey)` -> Updates `Decimal128` crash-free rates, evaluates `criticalStabilityThreshold`, and emits Home `WorkItem` on breach. - `requestAiRootCause(issueId, eventId, channelId, idempotencyKey)` -> Dispatches grounded AI worker on scrubbed event snapshot. ### Kafka Domain Events (Published & Consumed) - **Published:** `dev.error.issue.first_seen.v1`, `dev.error.issue.regressed.v1`, `dev.error.alert.triggered.v1`, `dev.error.release_stability.breached.v1`, `dev.error.killswitch.recommended.v1`. *(Strict rule: raw stack locals and unredacted user fields are excluded from Kafka payloads—only sanitized summaries and entity UUIDs are emitted).* - **Consumed:** `apm.issue.status_changed.v1` (auto-resolves linked `DevErrorIssue` when bug closes), `dev.deployment.completed.v1` (initializes `DevReleaseHealth` baseline), `dev.flag.toggled.v1` (annotates release timeline). ### `requiredWorkflows` in `app.manifest.json` 1. `dev-error-symbolication-and-grouping-wf` (Async OpenWhisk/Kafka symbolication of raw minified frames against `DevSymbolArtifact` + suspect commit lookup). 2. `dev-error-alert-and-stability-gate-wf` (Evaluates velocity windows and `Decimal128` stability breaches, deduplicates cooldowns, creates Home `WorkItem`s, and dispatches webhooks). 3. `dev-error-ai-seer-triage-wf` (Grounded AI root-cause & reproduction summarizer posting proposals to `projectChannelMessage`—strictly read-only against source repos, requiring human confirmation before creating any PR or `ApmIssue`). 4. `dev-error-retention-purge-wf` (Scheduled TTL cleanup of expired `DevErrorEvent` occurrences and temporary replay blobs while preserving aggregated `DevErrorIssue` counters). --- ## 9. Security, Privacy, Compliance & Non-Functional Requirements - **Zero-Secret & PII Scrubbing by Default (GDPR / CCPA / HIPAA / SOC2):** Server-side scrubbing executes *prior* to database persistence and AI prompt construction, stripping `Authorization` headers, cookies, API keys, JWTs, SSNs, payment card PANs (Luhn check), and client IPs by default. Payloads containing translated or user-authored strings are treated strictly as untrusted data (preventing prompt injection in AI triage and XSS in UI rendering via `escapeHtml()`). - **Right to Erasure & Configurable Retention:** Supports targeted purge of `DevErrorEvent` records matching an external user identifier hash within statutory GDPR windows, alongside configurable retention tiers (e.g., 30 / 60 / 90 days for raw events; 365 days for aggregated `DevReleaseHealth`). Cost/quota estimator displays usage transparently (e.g., \$0.00 overage surprises via deterministic inbound spike caps). - **Immutable Audit Trail:** All changes to `DevErrorService` scrubbing rules, DSN key rotations, `DevErrorAlertRule` thresholds, and manual issue merges write append-only platform audit records with actor identity, timestamp, and before/after diffs. - **Accessibility & Responsive Performance:** WCAG 2.2 AA compliant across `390px` (mobile on-call triage), `768px` (tablet), and `1440px` (desktop wide stack-trace inspector); keyboard-navigable stack frame accordions; `findSWR` cached inbox rendering `< 150ms` p95 and paginated API reads `< 400ms` p95. --- ## 10. Deterministic Acceptance Criteria 1. **Zero `projectId` & Platform UUID Compliance:** Inspecting all 8 `Dev*` schemas confirms zero `projectId`/`tenantId` fields, backend-generated UUIDs on create, and `00000000-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx` UUIDs in seed fixtures. 2. **Pre-Persistence PII Scrubbing:** Submitting an error payload containing a `Bearer eyJ...` header, `password` field, and valid Luhn credit card number persists `[Filtered]` placeholders in `DevErrorEvent` and records applied scrubber names in `scrubbingApplied`. 3. **Deterministic Deduplication & Regression Reopening:** Ingesting 50 occurrences of the same stack trace increments `DevErrorIssue.occurrenceCount` to `50` on a single issue; marking it `RESOLVED` in `v1.0.0` and ingesting a matching stack trace tagged `v1.1.0` automatically transitions `status` back to `UNRESOLVED` (`REGRESSED`). 4. **Conditional Snooze Expiry:** Snoozing an issue with `snoozeOccurrenceLimit = 10` hides it from the default `UNRESOLVED` filter until the 10th new event arrives, at which point it deterministically returns to `UNRESOLVED`. 5. **Exact `Decimal128` Stability Gate & Home `WorkItem`:** Recording `9,849` crash-free sessions out of `10,000` (`98.4900%`) against `criticalStabilityThreshold = 98.5000%` transitions `DevReleaseHealth.gateStatus` to `CRITICAL_BREACH` without float rounding error and creates a linked Rapider Home `WorkItem`. 6. **Bi-Directional `ApmIssue` Contract:** Clicking **Create APM Bug** on `#/issue-detail` invokes the guarded command, populates `linkedApmIssueId`, and consuming `apm.issue.status_changed.v1` (`DONE`) transitions the `DevErrorIssue` to `RESOLVED_IN_NEXT_RELEASE`. 7. **Sidebar Minimum 3 Items Rule:** Parsing `app.manifest.json` `webPages` confirms all 3 visible sidebar groups (`Overview & Triage`, `Releases & Services`, `Governance & Rules`) each contain exactly 3 visible items (`displayOnMenu: true`), while `issue-detail`, `release-detail`, and `service-drawer` set `displayOnMenu: false`. 8. **SWR Clean Query & Optimistic Triage/Delete:** Every page mount uses `findSWR`/`countSWR` with zero `isDeleted` clauses in `where`; resolving or deleting a record updates local in-memory arrays and `` synchronously, invalidates `sessionStorage` SWR keys, and rolls back cleanly on simulated API failure. 9. **Table Action & Contrast Compliance:** No data table contains a "View" button in `Actions`; primary identifiers navigate to `#/issue-detail` or `#/release-detail`; `Edit` renders icon + text; `Delete` renders icon-only with tooltip/`aria-label`; all primary/danger buttons compute `#ffffff` text color; zero `window.alert`/`confirm`/`prompt` calls exist in source. 10. **Active Filter Tags & Clear All:** Entering a search string or selecting environment/status pills on `#/issues` renders `#activeFilterTagsBar` with HTML-escaped dismissible chips and `Clear all`, synchronously updating both Table and `` views. 11. **Drawer Lifecycle & `finally` Button Reset:** Saving or cancelling `service-drawer` closes the drawer automatically, broadcasts `RECORD_CREATED`/`RECORD_UPDATED`, and restores the Save button inside a `finally` block so it never freezes on `"Saving..."`. 12. **Real Click-Through & Back Restoration E2E:** Clicking an issue link on `#/issues` transitions to `#/issue-detail?id=...` without `` 404 diversion, renders the stack trace, and clicking `#btnGoBack` restores `#/issues` with active filters intact. 13. **Grounded AI Safety Boundary:** Requesting AI root-cause analysis posts a citation-backed proposal on `projectChannelMessage` using only scrubbed `DevErrorEvent` data and never executes unconfirmed code changes or external provider calls when disabled by policy. 14. **Responsive & Theme Parity:** Deterministic light/dark `validate_theme` checks and layout assertions pass with zero horizontal overflow or overlapping controls at `390px`, `768px`, and `1440px`.
